title: Quick Start
headline: Create your AI profile in minutes
subtitle: Upload your CV to unlock stronger AI answers sooner, or skip and explore the product first.

card.title: Start with your CV
card.description: A processed CV is the fastest way to unlock AI chat and job-fit analysis. You can always come back later from the dashboard.

benefits.cvBody: Once your CV finishes processing, Profiley can answer recruiter questions with grounded evidence from your experience.
benefits.fastBody: There is no mandatory questionnaire here anymore. Upload once or skip for now and keep moving.
benefits.returnBody: Quick start stays available from the dashboard, so you can upload or refresh your CV later without resetting anything.
